ask: can u make a poll for who's bringing what, we keep going back and forth
sentence: A shared list of items where each person taps an open item to claim it or taps their own to give it back, and anyone can add more items.
use_when: A group is planning who brings what to a cookout, party, or potluck
People keep going back and forth about who covers which item
You need a claim list where each item has only one owner
The group wants to see which items are still open
dont_use_when: The group needs to vote on options or pick a winner
Costs need to be split or tracked between people
Tasks need due dates, reminders, or several owners per item
